notes.title: Projected Dreams OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamers,

Three weeks ago, we announced the release date of Projected Dreams, and time has gone by so quickly since then.
Without rambling on, we are so incredibly proud to announce that our debut game, Projected Dreams, is [b]OUT NOW[/b] on Steam!

Thank you so much to everyone who has stuck with us from the beginning, three years ago, until now! Regardless of how the launch goes, we’re extremely proud of what we’ve created and can’t wait for you to check it out!

If chill and puzzle games are your jam, please check out our bundles!
[list]
[*] Projected Dreams x Simpler Times
[*] Projected Dreams x ODDADA
[*] Sit Back and Relax Bundle (Projected Dreams, SCHiM, Sticky Business, Inbento, and Sizable)
[/list]
Alternatively, check out our supporter pack containing [b]31(!!) original soundtracks[/b] by our sound and music genius, Floris Demandt!

[b]Please leave a review as soon as you can! This helps us to push the Steam algorithm a bit![/b]

Once again, thank you for supporting a small studio like ours! It means the world to us!
We hope you enjoy Projected Dreams as much as we enjoyed making it! <3

Love always,
Flawberry Studio

notes.title: Projected Dreams releasing on May 29!
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamers,

Three years ago, we took part in the Brackeys Game Jam. 
Inspired by the theme “It’s not real,” we created a small prototype about a girl and her imagination. 
Little did we know that this small [i](and very buggy)[/i] prototype would grow into something much bigger than we ever expected.

After a confident start, five mid-life crises, a few highs and late-night shifts, and the occasional “Hey, this is actually a pretty cool game” comments during our internal playtests, we're ready.

Projected Dreams will officially launch on [b]May 29th[/b] or to be precise, in less than three weeks.

While we’re saving our (well-deserved) “thank-you” to the community for the next Steam announcement, we’d like to ask [b]one final favor[/b] before release:
Tell your friends, your family, and your fellow cozy gamers. Help us spread the word. Most importantly, mark your calendars to be notified when Projected Dreams launches. And if you enjoyed the game leave a review right away. It helps us more than you think.

We still can’t quite believe we’re about to release our first game as a studio. No matter how the launch goes, we’re incredibly proud of what we’ve created and of getting through the good, the bad, and the ugly.

Thank you for sticking with us. For believing in us. For your kind comments, your excitement, your bug reports, your visits to our convention booths, your shares, likes and comments on our social media channels, and your playtesting feedback…. we genuinely couldn’t have done this without your support.
[i](Whoops couldn’t help myself and ended up writing a big "thank-you" still hehe)[/i]

We can’t wait to push the button on May 29th.

See you there?

PS: Watch out release date announcement trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=LGPuUZKw4ok;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Open Playtest & Cozy Quest!
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamers!

I hope you are all doing well!

Today we are once again part of the Cozy Quest Steam Celebration, hosted by Secret Mode! We're suuuuper excited to be taking part again, especially since it helped us gain a lot of visibility last year! 

To celebrate the occasion, we are finally able to open a public playtest for Projected Dreams!
We have finished adding [b]mouse-only[/b] and [b]controller support[/b], which has been requested several times in the Steam forums and on our Discord server! 

Since these things take a lot of testing to get right, we thought a public playtest would be the best way to get a feel for whether they're good or what needs to be improved! 

But that's not all! We've added two levels for our latest chapter: [b]The Haunted House![/b] 
It introduces the ghost mechanic, where you can make objects invisible! 
Be sure to check it out and let us know what you think ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/52093e1600c30186fd94cfae485839c3814cc094.gif[/img]

We're grateful for everyone who checks out the playtest! Check out the Projected Dreams store page to get access to the playtest!

[b]Important when playing with controllers:[/b]

[i]To play with a controller, you need to ensure that Steam Input is disabled. To do that, execute the following steps:
[olist]
[*] Open Steam, navigate to the "Projected Dreams Playtest" in your library and connect the controller
[*] Press on the controller icon on the right side of the detailed view
[*] Press on "Disable Steam Input"
[/olist][/i]

Thank you for the massive support over the months! 
Projected Dreams has reached 13k wishlists, which is huge for us! 

Thank you all! And don't forget to check out the Cozy Quest Steam event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/1e805df3b677772f77b9121596efda7d58edf01b.jpg[/img]

Love always,
Flawberry Studio

notes.title: Celebrating a new Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamers,

To celebrate our participation in the Cozy Celebration event, we've decided to release a major update to our demo!  As all these improvements are quite big, let me break them down for you:

The biggest addition is the theatre room! Introducing a completely new mechanic which lets you overlap shadows through its two light sources!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/8c7491087e37b416db08801a6cc075c635b13464.jpg[/img]

Introducing the photo album, which drives the narrative and also acts as a level selection! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/2ba35bbea297e8f70a0049bed915847b0ecf67e0.jpg[/img]

New grading system added! The more accurate you are at solving each puzzle, the more hearts you will receive! This means that if you're just playing for the story, you can move on as soon as you reach one heart! Or for the completionists among you, you can try to get all three hearts in all the levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/c26674d74e2dae333d29f75cc0c73c8e95dfff30.jpg[/img]

We've hidden some music cassettes in some levels! When you find them, you can drag them into the tape recorder and listen to some funky or chilly tunes ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/8ddc5ad5d6fc7044882f3d55c562ddad80614be5.jpg[/img]

We removed the space station!
As we're currently reworking the entire space station, we've decided to remove it from the demo and add it back once the entire room has been reworked and the photo-illustrations are complete.

That's is for now! Let us know what you think of the demo so far!
We're planning to update the demo more often now!
And don't forget to add Projected Dreams to your wishlist <3

Flawberry Studio

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/e34447e5e1bfa65c6923c0ee1b0dff394932d6ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Ready to test Projected Dreams?
notes.notes:
We've been working on Projected Dreams for about a year and a half now, showing demo after demo at various events like Zurich PopCon and Fantasy Basel. We are now at a point where we can confidently release the first beta demo of Projected Dreams for a limited time to gather feedback and new ideas for the game!

During October, we will be exhibiting the demo at this year's [url=https://zurichpopcon.ch/en/indie-games]Zurich PopCon[/url], [url=https://www.egx.net/london/en-gb/things-to-do/panels/panel-information.html?gtID=821441&panel-name=Projected-Dreams]EGX London[/url], and [url=https://herofest.ch/de/exhibitors/2414]Herofest[/url]!

We're super excited to hear what you think about the beta so far, so please let us know if you found any bugs, have any new ideas, and more!

[h2]There's more![/h2]

Since this is the beta demo, the final version will have a lot more to offer. We have a few things planned that we talked about on our Discord, but let me list them here as well:

[h3]The storybook[/h3]
This book can be used as the main menu of the game. By flipping through the pages, you can choose which level or setting you want to replay. It also summarizes the main story and may even hide some levels you need to find first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44429554/9ef30aeb5ecd9be024e85aafe200122e061d055e.png[/img]

This is a super early screenshot as we are mainly working on the level selection right now. Other things we'd like to add are:

- Animated, new chapter selection illustrations
- Fleshed out story told through the book and shadow silhouettes
- Ability to find hidden levels inside the book
- Level rating to encourage replayability

[h2]The Story[/h2]
While we can't say much about the story yet, this part will be completely reworked in the current demo. We plan to give our main character Senka much more depth. 

If you want to give us feedback and support the development of our game, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/eXdbEM6k7t]Discord[/url] server to talk about all things cozy and nostalgic and give feedback!

Love always,
Flawberry Studio
